annotations.title: Upkeep job for a kind of appliance

description: Look up the routine upkeep for one kind of home device (for example a smoke alarm, a furnace filter or a dryer vent): how often it is due, what to buy for it, and the public safety body or maker page the interval comes from. Use it when someone asks how often something should be checked, cleaned or replaced. The list also holds the device types a smart home hub shows, such as "Smoke CO Alarm" or "Laundry Dryer". When the answer has "known": false, FrogCog has no sourced interval for that device in that country: say so, without suggesting one.

appliance.description: The kind of device, by FrogCog's short key, or the device type a smart home hub shows.
